title: China Bans Four New Zealand Lawmakers Over Taiwan Visit
detail: China imposed travel bans on four New Zealand parliamentarians after they made an official trip to Taiwan, escalating diplomatic pressure over cross-strait relations. Beijing condemned the visit as interference in China's internal affairs and warned other countries against following suit. The move reflects China's intensifying efforts to isolate Taiwan diplomatically and punish foreign officials who treat it as a sovereign state.
